results.body: tlsMutualAuthenticationCertificateChain contains the default CA bundled with MockServer, whose private key is published in the MockServer jar, so anyone could create a client certificate MockServer accepts: remove it from tlsMutualAuthenticationCertificateChain and use the CA chain that signs your client certificates, configure your own CA with certificateAuthorityCertificate and certificateAuthorityPrivateKey, or set dynamicallyCreateCertificateAuthorityCertificate=true; for a throwaway local test only, tlsMutualAuthenticationAllowBundledCa=true restores the old behaviour
